t: Infinite Regression: AI Collaboration Strategy for Pipulate
s: This article details recovering from a critical 'infinite regression' bug in Pipulate caused by AI coding partner's pattern misapplication. It introduces a 'strange loop' human-AI collaboration strategy and 'time-traveling eradication' via git reset to ensure stability.
sub: AI-induced 'infinite regression' bug in data persistence.
'Strange loop' human-AI collaboration strategy for bug recovery.
Time-traveling eradication (git reset --hard) to prevent regressions.
Automated git cherry-picking script for salvaging features.
Local-first AI user-tracking and its regression in Pipulate.
